name: Tanya
source:
A veteran adventurer who left her birthplace, Cane village, and travels the world.

Although she accepts the request of her brother [url=/c73281]Luis[/url] to return to her birthplace together with her disciple [url=/c73227]Lille[/url] to solve the strange phenomenon affecting the Cane village and its environs, she foists the investigation onto Lille alone and spends her days lazing around her family home, the local inn. Extremely fond of alcohol, she takes to the bottle every night and harasses Lille and Luis in her drunken state.

[Spoiler] She was entrusted with the tutelage of Lille by Lille's parents, who helped her in the past and hence could not turn down their request. Fully aware of Lille's talents, she knows one day Lille will surpass her but is happy to provide guidance until the day comes. Although extremely lazy, she also realizes Lille's potential can only be fully unleashed with practical experience. She will watch over Lille and will intervene when she judges Lille to be overpowered by her current foe.

When the village is affected by the spell of eternal night, she volunteers to scout the south road of Cane village. Unfortunately she is outmatched by the undead hordes and her life is saved when Lille intervenes to bring her back for emergency treatment.

She saved Mimi's life when she found her by chance in a deserted alleyway. She's also responsible for giving Mimi her current name and is her best friend. She initially writes a letter asking Mimi for assistance to resolve the problems around Cane village because magic is not her expertise.

The after-effects of her life-threatening injuries and her age (30+) eventually convince her to retire and help her brother Luis run the local village inn. [/Spoiler]
